name: What is the importance of proper ventilation in a roof replacement plan?

mainEntity.name: What is the importance of proper ventilation in a roof replacement plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper ventilation is critical in a roof replacement plan as it helps extend the life of your roof and improve your home's energy efficiency. Adequate attic ventilation prevents heat and moisture buildup, which can lead to premature shingle deterioration, wood rot, and mold growth. In the DFW climate, good ventilation helps regulate attic temperatures, reducing strain on your HVAC system during hot summers. A well-designed ventilation system is an integral part of a healthy and durable roof.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper ventilation extends roof life and improves energy efficiency by preventing heat and moisture buildup, which is crucial in climates like DFW.
